notes: Read both targets, context and all seven candidates. Split the pandemic compound; resolve the COVID-19 antecedent. Retain the Medicare-for-All/society model together rather than deciding that the ambiguous which clause describes a particular enacted program. Restore the requirement to create a culturally competent system; preserve the valid disparity and interlocking-crisis candidates.

claims.claim_text: By the 2021 adopted platform, COVID-19 has killed hundreds of thousands of people.
The COVID-19 pandemic has exposed major racial and economic health disparities in the United States.
The COVID-19 pandemic demonstrates the necessity of free health care for all.
National oppression, racism and colonialism worsen the COVID-19 pandemic's consequences for the Global South.
The Medicare for All model couples a society based on solidarity and caregiving with redirected resources and health care as a public good.
Support for creating a culturally competent U.S. health care system that listens to, honors and responds to Black and Brown patients' experiences.
